name.zh: Active Directory 只读枚举命令（工具迁移）
name.en: Read-Only Active Directory Enumeration Commands (Tool Migration)

description.zh: 该条目由多条产品或系统命令组成，已迁入对应工具卡维护命令、参数、前置条件和证据，不再作为独立 Payload 展示。
description.en: This entry contains multiple product or system commands and is migrated to the corresponding tool card for commands, parameters, prerequisites, and evidence rather than remaining a standalone payload.

subCategory.zh: Active Directory 只读枚举命令

prerequisites.zh: 确认资产、账号、域名或目录范围属于当前授权任务，并记录工具版本与查询时间。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that assets, identities, domains, and directory scope belong to the authorized task, recording tool versions and query time.

prerequisites.zh: 默认执行只读查询；任何写入、认证尝试、全端口扫描或配置变更必须另行批准。
prerequisites.en: Use read-only queries by default; writes, authentication attempts, full-port scans, and configuration changes require separate approval.

overview.zh: Active Directory 只读枚举命令 原卡片本质上是命令手册而不是可独立验证的输入载荷。迁移后，工具区统一维护安装、占位符、范围、预期输出和停止条件，Payload 区只保留可复现的技术边界。
overview.en: The original Read-Only Active Directory Enumeration Commands card is a command manual rather than an independently testable input payload. After migration, installation, placeholders, scope, expected output, and stop conditions are maintained in the tool section while the payload section retains reproducible technical boundaries.

vulnerability.zh: 查询结果、公开 DNS 记录、目录对象或源站响应本身不是漏洞；只有它们与授权边界、资产归属、访问控制或预期配置不一致，并有服务器端或控制面证据支持时，才构成有效发现。
vulnerability.en: Query results, public DNS records, directory objects, or origin responses are not vulnerabilities by themselves. A finding requires a mismatch with authorization, ownership, access control, or expected configuration supported by server-side or control-plane evidence.

exploitation.zh: 先确认身份与范围，再一次运行一条只读命令并保存原始输出；把结果与资产清单、目录配置、DNS、HTTP 头或审计日志交叉核对。出现非授权资产、敏感正文、状态变更或过量请求时立即停止。
exploitation.en: Confirm identity and scope, run one read-only command at a time, preserve raw output, and compare it with inventories, directory configuration, DNS, HTTP headers, or audit logs. Stop on unauthorized assets, sensitive bodies, state changes, or excessive requests.

mitigation.zh: 按实际发现收紧目录查询与高权限组、隐藏源站并限制仅 CDN 网段访问、统一证书和 Host 路由配置，并为异常枚举、直连尝试和配置漂移建立审计。修复后使用同一只读命令回归。
mitigation.en: Tighten directory queries and privileged groups, restrict origins to CDN networks, align certificate and Host routing configuration, and audit anomalous enumeration, direct-origin attempts, and drift. Re-run the same read-only commands after remediation.

title.zh: 建立Active Directory 只读枚举命令前置条件基线
title.en: Establish the Read-Only Active Directory Enumeration Commands Prerequisite Baseline

description.zh: 记录 Active Directory 只读枚举命令 的当前主体、单一授权资产、组件或工具版本、适用条件、正常基线和停止条件；不把工具存在或查询成功直接判定为漏洞。
description.en: Record the principal, one authorized asset, component or tool version, applicability conditions, normal baseline, and stop conditions for Read-Only Active Directory Enumeration Commands; do not treat tool availability or query success as a vulnerability.

title.zh: 运行一条Active Directory 只读枚举命令基线命令
title.en: Run One Read-Only Active Directory Enumeration Commands Baseline Command

description.zh: 只运行 Active Directory 只读枚举命令 的第一条只读命令并保存原始输出、时间戳和查询上下文，不并发扩展到其他资产。
description.en: Run only the first read-only Read-Only Active Directory Enumeration Commands command and preserve raw output, timestamps, and query context without expanding concurrently to other assets.

title.zh: 关联Active Directory 只读枚举命令权威证据
title.en: Correlate Authoritative Read-Only Active Directory Enumeration Commands Evidence

description.zh: 把命令结果与目录、DNS、CDN 控制面、资产清单和审计日志对照，区分正常可见性、配置漂移和真实越权。
description.en: Compare command output with directory, DNS, CDN control-plane, asset-inventory, and audit-log evidence to distinguish normal visibility, drift, and actual authorization failures.

title.zh: 修复并回归Active Directory 只读枚举命令
title.en: Remediate and Retest Read-Only Active Directory Enumeration Commands

description.zh: 完成 Active Directory 只读枚举命令 对应的最小权限、补丁或配置修复后，以相同主体和同一条命令回归，确认正常管理能力保留且原证据链不再成立。
description.en: After the least-privilege, patch, or configuration remediation for Read-Only Active Directory Enumeration Commands, retest with the same principal and command to confirm legitimate administration remains available and the original evidence chain no longer holds.

analysis.zh: 有效结论必须同时包含查询身份、明确范围、原始输出和权威配置或日志。命令成功、域对象存在、公开 DNS 记录或 HTTP 200 都不能单独证明安全问题。
analysis.en: A valid conclusion requires query identity, explicit scope, raw output, and authoritative configuration or logs. Command success, a directory object, a public DNS record, or HTTP 200 alone does not prove a security issue.

opsecTips.zh: 限制查询次数和输出字段，不保存凭证、Token、邮件正文或无关用户属性。
opsecTips.en: Limit query count and output fields, and do not retain credentials, tokens, mail bodies, or unrelated user attributes.

opsecTips.zh: 检测到超出授权的写操作、认证尝试、非授权资产或异常请求量时立即停止、回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on writes, authentication attempts, unauthorized assets, or abnormal request volume outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 原条目由 net、nltest 和 PowerView 枚举命令组成，属于工具命令手册；迁入 AD 域内枚举工具卡，不再作为独立 Payload 展示。

overview.en: The original ICMP Tunnel Capability and Interface Preflight card is a command manual rather than an independently testable input payload. After migration, installation, placeholders, scope, expected output, and stop conditions are maintained in the tool section while the payload section retains reproducible technical boundaries.

vulnerability.zh: 隧道、代理或客户端帮助输出不是漏洞。风险来自监听绑定超出回环、缺少认证、允许未批准目标、持久化启动或绕过分段策略，必须由进程参数、监听套接字、路由和流量日志证明。
vulnerability.en: Tunnel, proxy, or client help output is not a vulnerability. Risk comes from listeners beyond loopback, missing authentication, unapproved destinations, persistent startup, or segmentation bypass and must be proven through process arguments, sockets, routes, and traffic logs.

exploitation.zh: 先确认身份与范围，再一次运行一条只读命令并保存原始输出；把结果与资产清单、目录配置、DNS、HTTP 头或审计日志交叉核对。出现非授权资产、敏感正文、状态变更或过量请求时立即停止。
exploitation.en: Confirm identity and scope, run one read-only command at a time, preserve raw output, and compare it with inventories, directory configuration, DNS, HTTP headers, or audit logs. Stop on unauthorized assets, sensitive bodies, state changes, or excessive requests.

mitigation.zh: 默认绑定回环，限制单一 marker 服务和短时会话，启用身份校验、失败退出和集中日志，禁止全网段路由与持久化服务。回归时先检查参数和监听范围，再发送一个本地 marker 请求。
mitigation.en: Bind to loopback by default, limit testing to one marker service and a short-lived session, require identity checks and failure-on-forward, centralize logs, and prohibit broad routes or persistent services. Retest arguments and listener scope before one local marker request.

description.en: After the least-privilege, patch, or configuration remediation for ICMP Tunnel Capability and Interface Preflight, retest with the same principal and command to confirm legitimate administration remains available and the original evidence chain no longer holds.

opsecTips.en: Limit query count and output fields, and do not retain credentials, tokens, mail bodies, or unrelated user attributes.

opsecTips.en: Stop, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on writes, authentication attempts, unauthorized assets, or abnormal request volume outside the authorization.

name.zh: SSH 横向管理安全预检

description.zh: 覆盖 SSH 管理通道的横向移动验证：从密码登录、私钥文件认证到 -J 跳板机中转连接，检验窃取的 SSH 凭据与密钥在主机间跳转中的可用性及认证日志痕迹。
description.en: Covers lateral movement validation over the SSH management channel: from password login and private key authentication to proxied connections through a jump host with -J, verifying the usability of harvested SSH credentials and keys for pivoting between hosts and the traces left in authentication logs.

subCategory.zh: SSH 横向管理安全预检

prerequisites.zh: 确认资产、账号、域名或目录范围属于当前授权任务，并记录工具版本与查询时间。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that assets, identities, domains, and directory scope belong to the authorized task, recording tool versions and query time.

prerequisites.zh: 保留命令只可在书面授权、隔离、可回滚的实验中逐条执行；写入、认证、远程动作和凭据处理必须记录目标、主体与停止条件。
prerequisites.en: Run retained commands one at a time only in a written, isolated, reversible lab authorization; record target, principal, and stop conditions for writes, authentication, remote actions, or credential handling.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 SSH 通道的横向管理预检场景，检验口令、密钥与跳板三种认证路径的可达性。验证维度含直连、私钥认证与 ProxyJump 链路三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers lateral prechecks over the SSH channel, testing reachability of password, key and jump-host authentication paths. Validation covers direct connections, private-key auth and ProxyJump chains, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于长期有效的授权私钥与宽松的跳板授权：密钥文件泄露或跳板被控即可沿既有信任链直达内网主机，且免密特性绕过口令类监控。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is long-lived authorized private keys and loose jump-host grants: a leaked key file or compromised jump box rides the existing trust chain straight to intranet hosts, and passwordless login sidesteps password-centric monitoring.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步直接发起 SSH 连接，出现认证提示或进入 Shell 即确认 22 端口可达；第 2 步以私钥认证连接，免密进入目标 Shell 即确认密钥授权可用；第 3 步经跳板机用 -J 参数连接目标，验证链路后记录各跳主机与账号。以 Shell 获取为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；密钥仅使用授权测试密钥对。
exploitation.en: In step 1, connect directly over SSH; an auth prompt or shell confirms port 22 reachability. In step 2, connect with private-key auth; passwordless shell access confirms key authorization. In step 3, connect through the jump host with -J, then record each hop's host and account. Judge success by shell acquisition. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use only authorized test keypairs.

mitigation.zh: 私钥强制口令保护并集中托管，跳板访问收敛到堡垒机且启用双因素，审计 authorized_keys 变更。修复后重放第 2、3 步，非授权密钥与跳板应被拒绝并告警。
mitigation.en: Require passphrase-protected, centrally managed keys, funnel jump access through bastions with MFA, and audit authorized_keys changes. After the fix, replay steps 2 and 3: unauthorized keys and jumps should be denied with alerts.

description.en: Run only the first reviewed Safe SSH Lateral-Management Preflight command in the authorized lab, preserving raw output, timestamps, target-side logs, and rollback state without chaining other actions.

analysis.zh: 结论必须记录单一目标、身份、认证方式、监听地址、命令输出和服务端审计事件；帮助文本或端口开放不能单独证明横向移动风险。
analysis.en: Conclusions must record one target, identity, authentication method, listener address, command output, and server audit events; help text or an open port alone does not prove lateral-movement risk.

opsecTips.en: Limit query count and output fields, and do not retain credentials, tokens, mail bodies, or unrelated user attributes.

opsecTips.en: Stop, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on writes, authentication attempts, unauthorized assets, or abnormal request volume outside the authorization.

name.zh: WinRM 远程管理安全预检

description.zh: 覆盖 WinRM 远程管理通道的横向移动验证：从 PowerShell 远程会话建立与 Invoke-Command 命令执行，到 evil-winrm 交互式 Shell 接入，验证管理凭据在横向移动中的可用性与会话审计痕迹。
description.en: Covers lateral movement validation over the WinRM remote management channel: from establishing PowerShell remote sessions and running commands via Invoke-Command to interactive evil-winrm shell access, verifying the usability of management credentials for lateral movement and the session audit traces.

subCategory.zh: WinRM 远程管理安全预检

prerequisites.zh: 确认资产、账号、域名或目录范围属于当前授权任务，并记录工具版本与查询时间。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that assets, identities, domains, and directory scope belong to the authorized task, recording tool versions and query time.

prerequisites.zh: 保留命令只可在书面授权、隔离、可回滚的实验中逐条执行；写入、认证、远程动作和凭据处理必须记录目标、主体与停止条件。
prerequisites.en: Run retained commands one at a time only in a written, isolated, reversible lab authorization; record target, principal, and stop conditions for writes, authentication, remote actions, or credential handling.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 WinRM 远程管理通道的横向预检场景，检验 5985 或 5986 端口与凭据的远程执行可达性。验证维度含 PowerShell 交互会话、远程命令执行与 evil-winrm 三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers lateral-movement prechecks over the WinRM management channel, testing remote-execution reachability on ports 5985 or 5986 with given credentials. Validation covers an interactive PowerShell session, remote command execution and evil-winrm, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 WinRM 默认对具备本地管理员或远程管理组成员的凭据开放：凭据一旦泄露，攻击者无需额外漏洞即可获得受控主机的命令执行与交互 Shell。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is WinRM open by default to credentials in the local Administrators or Remote Management Users groups: once credentials leak, attackers gain command execution and an interactive shell on the host with no extra vulnerability needed.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 Enter-PSSession 携带测试凭据建立远程会话，进入交互提示符即确认端口与凭据可用；第 2 步以 Invoke-Command 执行 whoami，返回目标主机身份即确认命令执行面；第 3 步用 evil-winrm 连接获得交互 Shell，记录会话特性供后续操作。以远程命令回显为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；仅对授权主机发起连接。
exploitation.en: In step 1, establish a remote session with Enter-PSSession using test credentials; an interactive prompt confirms port and credential availability. In step 2, run whoami via Invoke-Command; the target-host identity confirms the execution surface. In step 3, obtain an interactive shell with evil-winrm and record session traits for follow-up. Judge success by remote command output. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; connect only to authorized hosts.

mitigation.zh: 限制 WinRM 监听范围与远程管理组成员，启用 HTTPS 传输与 just-enough-administration 约束。修复后重放第 1 至第 3 步，未授权凭据的会话应被拒绝且登录监控告警。
mitigation.en: Restrict WinRM listeners and Remote Management Users membership, enforce HTTPS transport, and constrain via Just Enough Administration. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 3: unauthorized-credential sessions should be denied with logon alerts.

title.zh: 建立WinRM 远程管理安全预检前置条件基线

name.zh: WinRS 横向管理能力预检

description.zh: 覆盖 WinRS 原生远程 Shell 客户端的横向移动验证：从 winrs 指定远程主机执行单条命令，到直接拉起 cmd 交互式 Shell，验证管理凭据经 Windows 远程 Shell 通道控制目标的能力与审计痕迹。
description.en: Covers lateral movement validation with the native WinRS remote shell client: from running a single command on the remote host via winrs to spawning an interactive cmd shell directly, verifying the ability of management credentials to control the target over the Windows remote shell channel and the audit traces.

subCategory.zh: WinRS 横向管理能力预检

prerequisites.zh: 确认资产、账号、域名或目录范围属于当前授权任务，并记录工具版本与查询时间。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that assets, identities, domains, and directory scope belong to the authorized task, recording tool versions and query time.

prerequisites.zh: 保留命令只可在书面授权、隔离、可回滚的实验中逐条执行；写入、认证、远程动作和凭据处理必须记录目标、主体与停止条件。
prerequisites.en: Run retained commands one at a time only in a written, isolated, reversible lab authorization; record target, principal, and stop conditions for writes, authentication, remote actions, or credential handling.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 WinRS 横向管理能力预检场景，检验单命令执行与交互通道两条路径的可用性。验证维度含远程命令执行与远程 cmd 拉起两步，对应第 1 至第 2 步。
overview.en: This payload covers WinRS lateral-management capability prechecks, testing single-command execution and interactive channel paths. Validation covers remote command execution and spawning a remote cmd, mapped to steps 1 and 2.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 WinRS 与 WinRM 共享同一信任模型且常与管理端口同时开放：持有有效凭据的攻击者用一条命令即可完成远程执行预检并升级为交互控制。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is WinRS sharing WinRM's trust model and typically coexisting with management ports: an attacker holding valid credentials prechecks remote execution with a single command and upgrades to interactive control.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 winrs 携带凭据远程执行 whoami，返回目标账户身份即确认远程执行可用；第 2 步以同一凭据拉起远程 cmd 验证交互通道，记录输出回传方式。以命令回显与通道建立为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；与第 1 步结果交叉核对以区分端口开放与凭据有效。
exploitation.en: In step 1, run whoami remotely with winrs carrying credentials; the target-account identity confirms remote execution. In step 2, spawn a remote cmd with the same credentials to verify the interactive channel, recording how output returns. Judge success by command output and channel establishment. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; cross-check with step 1 to separate open ports from valid credentials.

mitigation.zh: 与 WinRM 一并收紧监听与组成员，命令行审计覆盖 winrs 调用。修复后重放第 1、2 步，未授权凭据应被 401 拒绝且事件日志出现失败记录。
mitigation.en: Tighten listeners and group membership together with WinRM, and audit command lines covering winrs invocations. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 2: unauthorized credentials should get 401 with failure events logged.

name.zh: Windows 提权边界只读核对

description.zh: 覆盖 Windows 本地提权边界的只读盘点验证：从 whoami 特权与组信息核查、WinPEAS 自动化枚举，到 Everyone 可写服务权限与未引用服务路径两项经典提权向量的定位，梳理可滥用配置缺陷。
description.en: Covers read-only inventory validation of Windows local privilege escalation boundaries: from verifying privileges and group membership with whoami and automated WinPEAS enumeration to locating two classic escalation vectors, world-writable service permissions and unquoted service paths, mapping abuseable configuration flaws.

subCategory.zh: Windows 提权边界只读核对

prerequisites.zh: 确认资产、账号、域名或目录范围属于当前授权任务，并记录工具版本与查询时间。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that assets, identities, domains, and directory scope belong to the authorized task, recording tool versions and query time.

prerequisites.en: Run retained commands one at a time only in a written, isolated, reversible lab authorization; record target, principal, and stop conditions for writes, authentication, remote actions, or credential handling.

overview.zh: Windows 提权边界只读核对覆盖本地提权枚举场景：针对已获得目标主机低权限 shell 的测试主体，枚举可利用的令牌特权、服务配置与路径缺陷。验证维度涵盖特权清单检查、winPEAS 自动枚举、可写服务 ACL 与未引用服务路径四组。
overview.en: Read-Only Windows Privilege-Boundary Review covers local privilege-escalation enumeration: for a test principal holding a low-privilege shell on the target, enumerate exploitable token privileges, service configurations, and path flaws. Verification dimensions cover privilege inventory, winPEAS automated enumeration, writable service ACLs, and unquoted service paths.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是服务对象、二进制目录或注册表 ACL 配置过宽，或服务路径含空格未加引号、低权限主体持有 SeImpersonate 类特权；当高权限服务加载低权限主体可写的内容时，服务重启或触发即可替换执行并继承 SYSTEM。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is overly broad ACLs on service objects, binary directories, or registry keys, unquoted service paths containing spaces, or SeImpersonate-class privileges held by low-privileged principals; when a high-privilege service loads content writable by a low-privileged user, a restart or trigger executes the replacement with SYSTEM.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步 whoami /priv 检查令牌特权，出现 SeImpersonate/SeAssignPrimaryToken 即标记 Potato 类提权前提；第 2 步运行 winPEAS 自动汇总可利用配置；第 3 步用 accesschk 枚举 Everyone 可写服务，命中即确认服务 ACL 缺口，替换 binPath 指向的恶意二进制后等待服务启动；第 4 步筛出含空格未加引号的路径，配合可写目录放置同名二进制。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 checks token privileges with whoami /priv — SeImpersonate/SeAssignPrimaryToken marks a Potato-class prerequisite; step 2 runs winPEAS to summarize exploitable configurations; step 3 enumerates Everyone-writable services with accesschk — a hit confirms the service ACL gap, then swap in a malicious binary at binPath and await service start; step 4 filters unquoted spaced paths and plants a same-name binary in the writable directory. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 收紧服务对象、二进制目录与注册表 ACL，为含空格服务路径加引号，移除不必要的令牌特权并让服务以受管服务账号运行。修复后以同一低权限主体重放第 1、3 步枚举，不应再出现可写服务与未引用路径。
mitigation.en: Tighten ACLs on service objects, binary directories, and registry keys; quote spaced service paths, remove unnecessary token privileges, and run services under managed service accounts. After the fix, replay the step 1 and step 3 enumeration as the same low-privileged user: no writable services or unquoted paths should remain.

description.zh: 覆盖 Linux 本地提权边界的只读盘点验证：从全盘搜索 SUID 文件、sudo 权限与 cron 任务核查，到 LinPEAS 自动化信息收集，系统化定位可滥用的提权向量。
description.en: Covers read-only inventory validation of Linux local privilege escalation boundaries: from a system-wide SUID file search and sudo permission and cron job checks to automated LinPEAS information gathering, systematically locating abuseable escalation vectors.

subCategory.zh: Linux 提权边界只读核对

prerequisites.zh: 确认资产、账号、域名或目录范围属于当前授权任务，并记录工具版本与查询时间。

overview.zh: Linux 提权边界只读核对覆盖本地提权枚举场景：针对已获得目标主机低权限 shell 的测试主体，枚举 SUID 二进制、sudo 规则、计划任务与自动化枚举结果。验证维度涵盖 SUID 文件检索、sudo 授权清单、cron 任务审查与 linPEAS 全量扫描。
overview.en: Read-Only Linux Privilege-Boundary Review covers local privilege-escalation enumeration: for a test principal holding a low-privilege shell on the target, enumerate SUID binaries, sudo rules, scheduled tasks, and automated enumeration results. Verification dimensions cover SUID file discovery, the sudo grant list, cron task review, and a full linPEAS sweep.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 SUID/SGID 设置过宽、sudoers 存在 NOPASSWD 宽泛授权、cron 脚本或其父目录对低权限用户可写；当高权限执行链的文件、参数或环境（PATH、动态库搜索路径）可被低权限主体控制时，即可稳定抵达 root 执行点。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is overly broad SUID/SGID bits, permissive NOPASSWD sudoers entries, or cron scripts and their parent directories writable by low-privileged users; when the file, arguments, or environment (PATH, dynamic library search path) of a high-privilege execution chain is controllable, a stable path to root execution exists.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步检索全部 SUID 二进制并对照 GTFOBin 判断能否借此读文件或派生 root shell；第 2 步用 sudo -l 查看当前用户授权，NOPASSWD 条目即候选提权路径；第 3 步检查 /etc/crontab 与 cron 目录，定位低权限可写的脚本路径并注入命令等待调度执行；第 4 步运行 linPEAS 获取分类汇总，交叉验证前三步遗漏项。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 enumerates all SUID binaries and checks them against GTFOBins for file reads or root shells; step 2 reviews grants with sudo -l — NOPASSWD entries are candidate paths; step 3 inspects /etc/crontab and cron directories, locates low-privilege-writable script paths, and injects commands to await scheduling; step 4 runs linPEAS for a categorized sweep that cross-checks anything missed. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 移除非必要 SUID/SGID 与 file capabilities，sudo 采用精确命令与参数约束，修复 cron/systemd 脚本及父目录所有权，清理可写 PATH 与动态库搜索路径。修复后以同一 UID 重放第 1-3 步枚举，不应再出现可控的高权限执行点。
mitigation.en: Remove unnecessary SUID/SGID bits and file capabilities, constrain sudo to exact commands and arguments, fix cron/systemd script and parent-directory ownership, and clean writable PATH and library search entries. After the fix, replay the step 1-3 enumeration as the same UID: no controllable high-privilege execution points should remain.

description.en: Correlate UID and GID, mount options, expanded sudoers rules, file and parent-directory mode, owner and capabilities, task identity, and auditd or journal events. A GTFOBins match alone does not prove that the target configuration is exploitable.

title.zh: 修复并回归Linux 提权边界只读核对

analysis.zh: 结论必须给出主体、具体文件或规则、可控输入、高权限消费者和触发方式；只列出 SUID 文件、sudo -l 或内核版本属于发现线索而非提权证据。
analysis.en: A conclusion must identify the principal, exact file or rule, controllable input, privileged consumer, and trigger. A SUID list, sudo -l output, or kernel version is a lead rather than privilege-escalation proof.

opsecTips.zh: 限制查询次数和输出字段，不保存凭证、Token、邮件正文或无关用户属性。
opsecTips.en: Limit query count and output fields, and do not retain credentials, tokens, mail bodies, or unrelated user attributes.

opsecTips.en: Stop, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on writes, authentication attempts, unauthorized assets, or abnormal request volume outside the authorization.

name.zh: Linux 内核风险只读核对

description.zh: 覆盖 Linux 内核提权风险的只读核对：从 uname 与 /proc/version 提取版本指纹、searchsploit 检索可用漏洞，到 DirtyCow、DirtyPipe、PwnKit 等内核提权漏洞的适用性比对。
description.en: Covers read-only assessment of Linux kernel escalation risk: from extracting kernel version fingerprints via uname and /proc/version and searching matching exploits with searchsploit to comparing applicability of kernel escalation flaws such as DirtyCow, DirtyPipe and PwnKit.

subCategory.zh: Linux 内核风险只读核对

prerequisites.zh: 确认资产、账号、域名或目录范围属于当前授权任务，并记录工具版本与查询时间。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that assets, identities, domains, and directory scope belong to the authorized task, recording tool versions and query time.

prerequisites.zh: 保留命令只可在书面授权、隔离、可回滚的实验中逐条执行；写入、认证、远程动作和凭据处理必须记录目标、主体与停止条件。
prerequisites.en: Run retained commands one at a time only in a written, isolated, reversible lab authorization; record target, principal, and stop conditions for writes, authentication, remote actions, or credential handling.

overview.zh: Linux 内核风险只读核对覆盖内核提权场景：针对已获得目标主机低权限 shell 的测试主体，基于内核版本匹配可用的本地提权漏洞。验证维度涵盖内核版本采集、searchsploit 漏洞库检索与 DirtyCow/DirtyPipe/PwnKit 等常见 CVE 影响范围对照。
overview.en: Read-Only Linux Kernel Risk Review covers kernel privilege escalation: for a test principal holding a low-privilege shell on the target, match usable local privilege-escalation flaws against the kernel version. Verification dimensions cover kernel version collection, searchsploit database lookup, and comparison against common CVEs such as DirtyCow, DirtyPipe, and PwnKit.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是内核版本落后于发行版安全公告，存在 DirtyCow（CVE-2016-5195）、DirtyPipe（CVE-2022-0847）、PwnKit（CVE-2021-4034）等已在更新包中修复的本地提权缺陷；发行版可能回移补丁，适用性必须按内核包构建与配置判断而非仅看版本字符串。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a kernel version lagging the distribution security advisories, exposing local privilege-escalation flaws such as DirtyCow (CVE-2016-5195), DirtyPipe (CVE-2022-0847), and PwnKit (CVE-2021-4034) that updated packages already fix; distributions may backport patches, so applicability depends on the kernel package build and configuration rather than the version string alone.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步采集 uname -a 与 /proc/version 输出，记录精确内核版本与编译信息作为匹配基线；第 2 步用 searchsploit 按版本号检索可用本地提权条目；第 3 步对照 DirtyCow、DirtyPipe、PwnKit 等 CVE 的影响版本范围，命中即标记候选提权路径，再在授权环境中验证对应 exploit 代码。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 collects uname -a and /proc/version output, recording the exact kernel version and build info as the matching baseline; step 2 searches searchsploit by version for usable local escalation entries; step 3 compares against the affected ranges of DirtyCow, DirtyPipe, PwnKit, and similar CVEs — a match marks a candidate escalation path to validate with the corresponding exploit in an authorized environment. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 按发行版公告与已安装包版本确认修复状态，升级至受支持内核并完成必要重启，禁用不需要的用户命名空间与高风险模块；监控异常崩溃与提权行为。修复后重新采集第 1 步基线，确认版本已进入修复覆盖范围。
mitigation.en: Confirm fix status from distribution advisories and installed package versions, upgrade to a supported kernel with the required reboot, disable unneeded user namespaces and risky modules, and monitor anomalous crashes and escalation behavior. After the fix, recollect the step 1 baseline and confirm the version is within fixed ranges.

name.zh: Potato 工具能力安全预检

description.zh: 覆盖 Windows 服务账户令牌提权验证：先核查 SeImpersonate 等特权前提，再逐项检验 JuicyPotato、PrintSpoofer、GodPotato 等土豆家族工具的本地提权可用性与版本适用性。
description.en: Covers Windows service account token privilege escalation validation: first checking token privilege prerequisites such as SeImpersonate, then testing the local escalation usability and version applicability of the potato tool family including JuicyPotato, PrintSpoofer and GodPotato.

subCategory.zh: Potato 工具能力安全预检

prerequisites.zh: 确认资产、账号、域名或目录范围属于当前授权任务，并记录工具版本与查询时间。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that assets, identities, domains, and directory scope belong to the authorized task, recording tool versions and query time.

prerequisites.zh: 保留命令只可在书面授权、隔离、可回滚的实验中逐条执行；写入、认证、远程动作和凭据处理必须记录目标、主体与停止条件。
prerequisites.en: Run retained commands one at a time only in a written, isolated, reversible lab authorization; record target, principal, and stop conditions for writes, authentication, remote actions, or credential handling.

overview.zh: Potato 工具能力安全预检覆盖 Windows 令牌模拟提权场景：针对持有 SeImpersonate/SeAssignPrimaryToken 特权的服务上下文测试主体，验证各代 Potato 工具能否借本地接口欺骗获得 SYSTEM。验证维度涵盖特权前提核对与 JuicyPotato/PrintSpoofer/SweetPotato/GodPotato/RoguePotato 五种工具链路。
overview.en: Safe Potato-Tool Capability Preflight covers Windows token-impersonation escalation: for a test principal in a service context holding SeImpersonate/SeAssignPrimaryToken, verify whether successive Potato tools obtain SYSTEM via local interface spoofing. Verification dimensions cover the privilege prerequisites and five tool chains: JuicyPotato, PrintSpoofer, SweetPotato, GodPotato, and RoguePotato.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是服务账户默认持有 SeImpersonatePrivilege，而 Windows 本地 COM、命名管道与打印接口允许借认证回调获取高权限令牌；各工具利用的接口随系统版本与补丁变化，需要按环境选择可用链路。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that service accounts hold SeImpersonatePrivilege by default while Windows local COM, named pipe, and printer interfaces allow capturing high-privilege tokens through authentication callbacks; the interfaces each tool abuses vary with OS version and patches, so chain choice depends on the environment.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步 whoami /priv 确认 SeImpersonate 或 SeAssignPrimaryToken 存在即满足前提；第 2 步用 JuicyPotato 以指定端口执行命令，proof 文件写出或反弹到达监听即确认；第 3 步用 PrintSpoofer 适配新系统；第 4 步用 SweetPotato 按触发器（如 EfsRpc）选择；第 5 步用 GodPotato 覆盖已打补丁的 .NET 环境；第 6 步用 socat 转发 135 后以 RoguePotato 处理受限场景；第 7 步输出标记确认链路贯通。按系统版本选工具。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 confirms SeImpersonate or SeAssignPrimaryToken via whoami /priv to satisfy prerequisites; step 2 executes a command with JuicyPotato on a chosen port — the proof file written or a reverse connection at the listener confirms; step 3 adapts to newer systems with PrintSpoofer; step 4 selects SweetPotato by trigger (e.g., EfsRpc); step 5 covers patched .NET environments with GodPotato; step 6 forwards port 135 with socat and applies RoguePotato for constrained scenarios; step 7 emits the marker to verify the chain. Choose the tool by OS version. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 移除不需要的 SeImpersonate/SeAssignPrimaryToken 特权，避免高权限服务向低信任主体暴露可模拟的本地接口，应用系统与 .NET 补丁；监控异常命名管道、COM/RPC 调用与 SYSTEM 子进程。修复后用第 2-6 步样例回归，各工具链应全部失败。
mitigation.en: Remove unneeded SeImpersonate/SeAssignPrimaryToken privileges, keep privileged services from exposing impersonable local interfaces to low-trust principals, and apply OS and .NET patches; monitor anomalous named pipes, COM/RPC calls, and SYSTEM child processes. After the fix, regress with the step 2-6 samples: every tool chain must fail.

name.zh: 进程注入能力安全预检

description.zh: 覆盖 Windows 进程注入能力验证：从经典 DLL 注入的远程内存写入流程、Process Hollowing 挂起进程替换五步链，到 APC 注入的异步队列调用，检验注入手法在终端防护下的行为特征。
description.en: Covers Windows process injection capability validation: from the remote memory write flow of classic DLL injection and the five-step suspended process replacement chain of Process Hollowing to APC injection via asynchronous queue calls, examining the behavioral signatures of injection under endpoint protection.

subCategory.zh: 进程注入能力安全预检

prerequisites.zh: 确认资产、账号、域名或目录范围属于当前授权任务，并记录工具版本与查询时间。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that assets, identities, domains, and directory scope belong to the authorized task, recording tool versions and query time.

prerequisites.zh: 保留命令只可在书面授权、隔离、可回滚的实验中逐条执行；写入、认证、远程动作和凭据处理必须记录目标、主体与停止条件。
prerequisites.en: Run retained commands one at a time only in a written, isolated, reversible lab authorization; record target, principal, and stop conditions for writes, authentication, remote actions, or credential handling.

overview.zh: 进程注入能力安全预检覆盖跨进程代码执行场景：针对已获得终端执行上下文的测试主体，验证经典 DLL 注入、进程镂空与 APC 注入三条链路的可行性与遥测可见性。验证维度涵盖跨进程写入链、挂起进程映像替换与异步过程调用劫持。
overview.en: Safe Process-Injection Capability Preflight covers cross-process code execution: for a test principal holding an execution context on the endpoint, verify the feasibility and telemetry visibility of classic DLL injection, process hollowing, and APC injection. Verification dimensions span the cross-process write chain, suspended-process image replacement, and asynchronous procedure call hijacking.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Windows 允许持有足够句柄权限的进程对其他进程执行 VirtualAllocEx+WriteProcessMemory+CreateRemoteThread；镂空与 APC 变体进一步让恶意代码借用合法进程映像运行，检测必须依赖跨进程访问与映像一致性告警。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that Windows lets a process with sufficient handle rights run VirtualAllocEx+WriteProcessMemory+CreateRemoteThread against other processes; hollowing and APC variants further let malicious code run under a legitimate process image, so detection must rely on cross-process access and image-consistency alerts.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步对 notepad 执行经典 DLL 注入链（OpenProcess→VirtualAllocEx→WriteProcessMemory→CreateRemoteThread），目标模块列表出现注入 DLL 即确认成功；第 2 步按 CREATE_SUSPENDED→NtUnmapViewOfSection→VirtualAllocEx→WriteProcessMemory→ResumeThread 顺序完成镂空，挂起进程映像被替换并恢复执行即确认；第 3 步用 QueueUserAPC 把 LoadLibraryA 挂入目标线程，线程唤醒后加载 DLL 即确认。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 runs the classic DLL injection chain against notepad (OpenProcess→VirtualAllocEx→WriteProcessMemory→CreateRemoteThread) — the injected DLL appearing in the target's module list confirms success; step 2 completes hollowing in the CREATE_SUSPENDED→NtUnmapViewOfSection→VirtualAllocEx→WriteProcessMemory→ResumeThread order — the suspended process image replaced and resumed confirms; step 3 queues LoadLibraryA into the target thread with QueueUserAPC — DLL load on wake confirms. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 启用进程访问审计与 EDR 跨进程注入检测，按路径和发布者收紧 AppLocker/WDAC 规则并限制 SeDebugPrivilege 分配；对跨进程写内存与远程线程创建实时告警。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，注入应被阻断或产生高置信告警。
mitigation.en: Enable process-access auditing and EDR cross-process injection detections, tighten AppLocker/WDAC rules by path and publisher, and restrict SeDebugPrivilege assignments; alert in real time on cross-process memory writes and remote thread creation. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: injection must be blocked or raise a high-confidence alert.

name.zh: AppLocker 与 LOLBin 策略预检

description.zh: 覆盖 AppLocker 白名单策略绕过验证：从白名单路径受信二进制执行，到 regsvr32、mshta、certutil 等 LOLBAS 载荷加载与 InstallUtil、MSBuild 编译执行，检验应用控制策略覆盖缺口。
description.en: Covers AppLocker whitelist policy bypass validation: from execution of trusted binaries in whitelisted paths to LOLBAS payload loading via regsvr32, mshta and certutil plus compile-and-run variants with InstallUtil and MSBuild, probing coverage gaps in application control policy.

subCategory.zh: AppLocker 与 LOLBin 策略预检

prerequisites.zh: 确认资产、账号、域名或目录范围属于当前授权任务，并记录工具版本与查询时间。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that assets, identities, domains, and directory scope belong to the authorized task, recording tool versions and query time.

prerequisites.zh: 保留命令只可在书面授权、隔离、可回滚的实验中逐条执行；写入、认证、远程动作和凭据处理必须记录目标、主体与停止条件。
prerequisites.en: Run retained commands one at a time only in a written, isolated, reversible lab authorization; record target, principal, and stop conditions for writes, authentication, remote actions, or credential handling.

overview.zh: AppLocker 与 LOLBin 策略预检覆盖应用控制策略绕过场景：针对部署 AppLocker 的终端，验证白名单路径内原生二进制能否承担下载与执行职责。验证维度涵盖白名单可执行核对、regsvr32/mshta/certutil LOLBAS 链、InstallUtil 卸载回调与 MSBuild 内联任务四类。
overview.en: AppLocker and LOLBin Policy Preflight covers application-control bypass: on endpoints with AppLocker deployed, verify whether native binaries inside allowlisted paths can shoulder download and execution duties. Verification dimensions cover allowlisted executable checks, regsvr32/mshta/certutil LOLBAS chains, InstallUtil uninstall callbacks, and MSBuild inline tasks.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 AppLocker 默认规则放行 System32 与 Program Files 内签名二进制，而其中部分原生工具可加载外部脚本或内联代码（regsvr32、mshta、certutil、InstallUtil、MSBuild），形成无需落盘新二进制的执行通道，使路径白名单策略失效。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that default AppLocker rules allow signed binaries within System32 and Program Files, several of which can load external scripts or inline code (regsvr32, mshta, certutil, InstallUtil, MSBuild), creating execution channels without dropping new binaries and defeating path-allowlist policy.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步核对白名单内可执行文件运行是否触发 8003/8004 拦截事件，确定可用入口；第 2 步用 regsvr32 加载远程 SCT、mshta 执行 HTA 或 certutil 下载载荷，回连主机收到对应请求即确认 LOLBAS 链路；第 3 步用 InstallUtil /U 在卸载回调中执行载荷且无 AppLocker 拦截；第 4 步用 MSBuild 编译执行 csproj 内联任务，宿主进程为 MSBuild.exe 即确认。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 checks whether running allowlisted executables triggers 8003/8004 block events to identify viable entries; step 2 loads a remote SCT with regsvr32, executes an HTA with mshta, or downloads a payload with certutil — the callback host receiving the request confirms the LOLBAS chain; step 3 executes the payload inside InstallUtil /U's uninstall callback without AppLocker blocks; step 4 compiles inline tasks with MSBuild — MSBuild.exe as the host process confirms. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 按路径与发布者收紧 AppLocker/WDAC 规则，对 regsvr32/mshta/InstallUtil/MSBuild 采用哈希或版本限定，启用 8003/8004/8006/8007 事件监控并审计代理执行命令行。修复后用第 2-4 步样例回归，全部 LOLBAS 链应被策略拒绝。
mitigation.en: Tighten AppLocker/WDAC rules by path and publisher, pin regsvr32/mshta/InstallUtil/MSBuild by hash or version, monitor 8003/8004/8006/8007 events, and audit proxy-execution command lines. After the fix, regress with the step 2-4 samples: every LOLBAS chain must be denied by policy.

name.zh: 签名二进制策略安全预检

description.zh: 覆盖签名二进制滥用的规避验证：从 MSBuild 编译执行 csproj、InstallUtil 反卸载程序集、regsvcs/regasm 注册组件，到 rundll32 执行 JavaScript 与 CPL 载荷，检验签名进程滥用面。
description.en: Covers defense evasion validation through signed binary abuse: from compiling and executing csproj with MSBuild and uninstalling assemblies with InstallUtil and registering components via regsvcs/regasm to running JavaScript and CPL payloads through rundll32, probing the abuse surface of signed processes.

subCategory.zh: 签名二进制策略安全预检

prerequisites.zh: 确认资产、账号、域名或目录范围属于当前授权任务，并记录工具版本与查询时间。

prerequisites.en: Run retained commands one at a time only in a written, isolated, reversible lab authorization; record target, principal, and stop conditions for writes, authentication, remote actions, or credential handling.

overview.zh: 签名二进制策略安全预检覆盖签名宿主代理执行场景：针对仅校验主进程签名的应用控制策略，验证微软签名二进制能否承担载荷执行。验证维度涵盖 MSBuild 内联任务、InstallUtil 卸载回调、regsvcs/regasm 组件加载与 Rundll32 导出调用四类。
overview.en: Safe Signed-Binary Policy Preflight covers signed-host proxy execution: against application control that validates only the main process signature, verify whether Microsoft-signed binaries can carry payload execution. Verification dimensions cover MSBuild inline tasks, InstallUtil uninstall callbacks, regsvcs/regasm component loading, and Rundll32 export invocation.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用控制策略放行 System32 与 .NET Framework 目录内签名二进制，而 MSBuild、InstallUtil、regsvcs/regasm、Rundll32 均可加载外部代码或脚本；宿主进程签名可信使仅凭进程签名的判断失效。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is application control allowing signed binaries within System32 and the .NET Framework directory while MSBuild, InstallUtil, regsvcs/regasm, and Rundll32 can all load external code or scripts; the trusted host-process signature defeats judgments based on process signature alone.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 MSBuild 编译执行 csproj 内联任务，宿主进程为 MSBuild.exe 即确认成功；第 2 步用 InstallUtil /U 在卸载回调中执行载荷；第 3 步用 regsvcs 或 regasm 以 .NET 组件身份执行载荷；第 4 步用 Rundll32 调用 mshtml RunHTMLApplication 或 cpl 导出，宿主保持 rundll32.exe 即确认。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 compiles inline tasks with MSBuild — MSBuild.exe as the host process confirms success; step 2 executes the payload inside InstallUtil /U's uninstall callback; step 3 runs it as a .NET component via regsvcs or regasm; step 4 invokes mshtml RunHTMLApplication or a cpl export with Rundll32 — rundll32.exe remaining the host confirms. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 对签名二进制采用哈希或版本限定并启用依赖签名校验，监控父进程异常的 MSBuild/InstallUtil/rundll32 调用与完整命令行；EDR 记录完整模块加载链。修复后用第 1-4 步样例回归，代理执行应被策略或告警捕获。
mitigation.en: Pin signed binaries by hash or version, enable dependency signature checks, and monitor MSBuild/InstallUtil/rundll32 invocations with anomalous parents and full command lines; have EDRs record the complete module-load chain. After the fix, regress with the step 1-4 samples: proxy execution must be caught by policy or alerts.

name.zh: 计划任务持久化安全核对

description.zh: 覆盖计划任务持久化验证：从 schtasks 创建登录触发与周期触发的后门任务、PowerShell Register-ScheduledTask 编程注册，到 Linux crontab 编辑，跨平台检验计划任务驻留面与检测点。
description.en: Covers scheduled task persistence validation: from creating logon-triggered and interval-triggered backdoor tasks with schtasks and programmatic registration via PowerShell Register-ScheduledTask to editing Linux crontab, examining task persistence surfaces and detection points across platforms.

subCategory.zh: 计划任务持久化安全核对

prerequisites.zh: 确认资产、账号、域名或目录范围属于当前授权任务，并记录工具版本与查询时间。

prerequisites.en: Run retained commands one at a time only in a written, isolated, reversible lab authorization; record target, principal, and stop conditions for writes, authentication, remote actions, or credential handling.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖计划任务持久化安全核对场景，检验登录触发、周期触发与跨平台注册的任务植入面。验证维度含 schtasks 登录与定时任务、PowerShell 注册与 crontab 编辑四步，对应第 1 至第 4 步。
overview.en: This payload covers scheduled-task persistence safety checks, testing implantation across logon-triggered, interval-triggered and cross-platform registration. Validation covers schtasks logon and interval tasks, PowerShell registration and crontab editing, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于计划任务以定义者权限自动执行且名称可伪装系统任务：SYSTEM 触发任务与分钟级周期任务落盘后长期驻留，蓝队若无任务基线则难以定位。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is scheduled tasks auto-executing with their definer's privileges behind spoofable system-like names: SYSTEM-triggered and minute-interval tasks persist on disk indefinitely, hard to spot without a task baseline.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 schtasks 创建 SYSTEM 登录触发任务并回读确认；第 2 步创建 5 分钟间隔任务验证周期执行；第 3 步以 PowerShell 注册同义任务确认两接口痕迹一致；第 4 步在测试环境打开 crontab 核对 Linux 侧用户级任务。以任务回读与执行记录为判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试后删除全部任务。
exploitation.en: In step 1, create a SYSTEM logon-trigger task with schtasks and confirm via read-back. In step 2, create a 5-minute interval task verifying periodic runs. In step 3, register an equivalent task with PowerShell confirming consistent artifacts. In step 4, open crontab in the test environment for the Linux side. Judge by task read-back and execution records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; delete all tasks after testing.

mitigation.zh: 以任务清单为基线监控创建与修改事件（4698、4699），约束非管理员创建 SYSTEM 触发任务。修复后重放第 1、2 步，创建应即时告警并在基线比对中标记。
mitigation.en: Baseline the task inventory and monitor creation and modification events (4698, 4699), blocking non-administrators from creating SYSTEM-triggered tasks. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 2: creation should alert instantly and stand out in baseline diffs.

prerequisites.zh: 确认资产、账号、域名或目录范围属于当前授权任务，并记录工具版本与查询时间。

overview.zh: 无人值守凭证文件安全核对覆盖部署残留凭据场景：针对已获得目标主机低权限 shell 的测试主体，枚举无人值守安装与部署配置中的残留秘密。验证维度涵盖默认路径检索、全盘 unattend 检索、AutoLogon 密码解析、编码解码与 GPP/SYSVOL/VNC/WLAN 凭据核对。

Verification dimensions cover default-path and full-disk unattend searches, AutoLogon password parsing, encoded-value decoding, and GPP/SYSVOL/VNC/WLAN credential checks.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Windows 自动部署与组策略首选项把凭据写入本地 XML、SYSVOL GPP 或注册表，部署完成后未清理且默认可读；Base64/Unicode 编码只是混淆，cpassword 使用公开 AES 密钥，均可直接还原为明文。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is Windows unattended setup and Group Policy preferences writing credentials into local XML, SYSVOL GPP, or the registry, left behind and readable by default after deployment; Base64/Unicode encoding is mere obfuscation and cpassword uses a published AES key, so both revert directly to plaintext.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步检索 Panther/Sysprep 默认路径，命中 Unattend.xml 即确认凭据残留可查；第 2 步全盘检索 unattend/sysprep XML 扩大范围；第 3 步解析 XML 提取 AutoLogon 密码明文；第 4 步用 Base64/Unicode 与 certutil 两种方式解码验证编码残留；第 5 步核对 SYSVOL cpassword、web.config 连接串、VNC 与 WLAN 密码；第 6 步用 Metasploit 模块批量枚举。任一明文命中即确认凭据暴露。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 searches Panther/Sysprep default paths — a hit on Unattend.xml confirms residual credentials are reachable; step 2 searches the whole disk for unattend/sysprep XML to widen scope; step 3 parses the XML for plaintext AutoLogon passwords; step 4 decodes residuals via Base64/Unicode and certutil; step 5 checks SYSVOL cpassword, web.config connection strings, VNC and WLAN passwords; step 6 batches enumeration with Metasploit modules. Any plaintext hit confirms credential exposure. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 从镜像、部署共享与历史 GPO 移除秘密并轮换已暴露账号，采用 LAPS/gMSA 或密钥保管服务，收紧 Panther 与部署目录 ACL 并审计敏感字段读取。修复后用第 1、3 步样例回归，默认路径不再返回可读凭据。
mitigation.en: Purge secrets from images, deployment shares, and historical GPOs, rotate exposed accounts, adopt LAPS/gMSA or a secrets vault, tighten Panther and deployment directory ACLs, and audit sensitive-field reads. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 3 samples: default paths must yield no readable credentials.

description.zh: 覆盖 SQL 注入入口的只读测试验证：从经典恒真条件绕过、UNION SELECT 列数探测，到 SLEEP 时间盲注延迟确认，检验注入点存在性与回显、延时两条确认路径。
description.en: Covers read-only testing validation of SQL injection entry points: from classic tautology bypass and UNION SELECT column-count probing to SLEEP time-based blind injection confirmation, verifying injection point existence along both echo and delay confirmation paths.

overview.en: This payload covers read-only SQL injection prechecks, providing three baseline statement classes for authorized tests to gauge injection-point behavior. Validation covers tautology conditions, UNION column probing and time-based blind probing, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于目标接口把用户输入拼接进 SQL 语句：引号闭合与注释符改变查询结构，恒真条件返回超额数据、UNION 泄露列结构、延时函数暴露执行通道。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is target interfaces concatenating user input into SQL: quote closing and comment markers restructure queries, tautologies return excess data, UNIONs expose column structure, and delay functions reveal execution channels.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把恒真条件、UNION 探列与 SLEEP 三条预检语句逐条注入目标参数并观察响应差异：返回异常数据量、列数错误提示或可测延迟即确认对应注入行为，再据结果路由到专项注入工具深入利用。成功判据以三类语句的差异化响应为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；全部探测保持只读。
exploitation.en: In step 1, inject the tautology, UNION-probe and SLEEP statements into target parameters one by one per the script, observing response differences; abnormal data volumes, column-count errors or measurable delays confirm the corresponding injection behavior, then route to specialized injection tooling for deeper exploitation based on results. mitigation.zh: 全面改用参数化查询并对输入做类型与格式校验，数据库账号最小权限并监控异常查询模式。修复后重放第 1 步，三类语句应返回统一错误且无延时差异。
mitigation.en: Move wholesale to parameterized queries with type and format validation, least-privilege database accounts, and monitoring of anomalous query patterns. After the fix, replay step 1: all three statement classes should return uniform errors with no timing deltas.
